title: Morning Hitsheet + Dial Ops
body:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for morning outreach and CRM action items. Focus: convert trials, book 2 architecture demos, clear follow-ups for Dedicated asks.

Today targets:
- Total dials: 20+ (manual + cadence)
- Connects: 5-8
- Demos to schedule: 2
- CRM updates: within 90 minutes after each call

Priority accounts (top-down):
1) AstraCare (Head of Engineering: Omar Ruiz)
   - Context: 10-seat trial for clinical-document search, using embeddings. Security questions around PHI storage.
   - Goal: book 30-min demo showing Private deployment pattern + HIPAA controls.
   - Quick opener: "Omar, saw the trial activity on clinical search — can I show a secure deployment pattern that keeps PHI in your VPC and reduces inference cost with prefix caching?"
   - Next step: call -> leave VM -> email HIPAA one-pager + suggest Wed 10am slot.

2) PixelSupply (CTO: Anya Desai)
   - Context: PoC for AI-assistant on ecommerce catalog; latency sensitivity for site UX.
   - Goal: propose Redwood Optimize pilot (KV caching + micro-batching) and run a 48h perf trace.
   - Objection handle: "Latency concerns" -> "We can run a zero-cost perf trace on a small slice of traffic and show p50/p95 with Dedicated baseline."
   - Next step: request sample prompts + 20-min tech sync.

3) Bridgewave (VP Product: Theo Marsh)
   - Context: procurement asked for on-prem checklist; legal looped in last week.
   - Goal: intro Solutions + Legal to move from review -> PO.
   - Next step: schedule 15-min legal intro, attach KMS/HSM brief.

Morning cadence (blocks):
- 08:30-09:00: quick warm dials (10 numbers) & voicemails
- 09:15-10:00: technical outreach & trial owners (deeper calls)
- 11:00-11:30: follow-up email batch (tailored snippets + calendly)
- 14:00-15:30: demo ops / coordinate with solutions eng

Email snippets (copy-paste):
- Post-VM short: "Left a note — saw trial activity spike. 20 mins to walk options for secure infra + cost-savings? Calendly: https://calendly.com/lena-30"
- After call (send resources): "Thanks for the time — attaching the Dedicated starter sheet and the KMS brief. Happy to review on a quick call."

Connect lines (short):
- "Quick Q on infra: are you leaning private deployment or hosted for this launcher?"
- "We recently helped an ecommerce team cut token spend ~30% via caching; worth a 15-min look?"

Objection cheats (one-liners):
- "We host ourselves" -> "Great — mind if I run a quick cost/latency comparison on a small sample? No infra changes needed for the comparison."
- "Security/regulatory" -> "We support Private with customer-managed KMS and audit logs; can connect our security engineer."

CRM nudges (todo):
- Move AstraCare to "demo requested" when invite is sent
- Tag PixelSupply with "perf-request" and add to queue for infra team
- Mark Bridgewave as "legal-review" and set reminder in 5 business days

Notes-to-self / experiments:
- A/B two subject lines for follow-ups: "Quick perf baseline?" vs "15 mins: reduce inference cost"
- Clip 1 positive objection-handling call per week for coaching (Gong)
- Re-request updated Dedicated pricing from Marco if finance numbers changed post-Q2

Open questions / blockers:
- Who owns the updated HIPAA one-pager? (Tara?)
- Does infra have bandwidth for PixelSupply perf run this week? Ping @infra-sched

End-of-day checklist:
- Log every call with outcome and next action in CRM
- Send brief to #ae-queue with 3 wins/blockers
- Create follow-up tasks in linear for any legal/solutions intros

Mini call log (quick stamps):
- 08:32 AM: left VM AstraCare (sent follow-up email)
- 08:48 AM: connected Bridgewave procurement (legal intro requested)
- 09:05 AM: voicemail PixelSupply (asked for sample prompts)

Status: draft — will refine into shared playbook if play works twice this week.
